context: High-end warm architectural one-pager for 'Haus Winter' (Owner: Joscho Winter, Kuppenstraße 38, 36275 Kirchheim, Hessen). Caters to craftsmen/Monteure, business travelers, and holiday short-stays seeking premium comfort ('gehobene Klasse'). Features bilingual toggle (DE/EN), pricing calculator with tiered duration discounts (daily, >1 week, >1 month), visual room catalog, interactive amenities bento, location connectivity highlights (200m autobahn & retail, walkable restaurants), interactive booking/contact inquiry form with backend email dispatch, and rich cinematic interactions.
archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY with Architectural Precision (Warm ochre, rich terracotta, deep forest charcoal, warm ivory/sand background)

fonts.heading: Playfair Display Variable
fonts.rationale: Playfair Display provides high-craft warmth, hospitable dignity, and authentic German guesthouse prestige ('Haus Winter' editorial character), avoiding sterile generic SaaS sans. DM Sans delivers effortless legibility for long German words ('Aufenthaltsraum', 'Monteurunterkunft', 'Dachterrasse') across mobile and desktop. JetBrains Mono adds precise tactile numeric clarity to rates, distances, and room specs.

entry_surfaces./: Asymmetric Split Hero: left editorial brand statement, animated badge, and primary CTA; right layered framed visual with live occupancy indicator and instant rate pill.

motion.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling for organic weight and momentum
motion.stagger_reveal: Masked upward slide on hero elements (opacity: 0, y: 24 -> opacity: 1, y: 0)

accessibility.text_contrast: All text tokens exceed 4.5:1 ratio against their defined backgrounds (e.g., #1F1D1A on #FAF7F2 is 14.8:1, #FFFFFF on #C45B28 is 5.1:1)
accessibility.focus_indicators: High contrast 2px ring in warm ochre (`focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#C45B28]`)
accessibility.data_testid_convention: All buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and interactive triggers MUST include role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='room-tab-single', data-testid='inquiry-submit-btn')

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `lenis` or use `@studio-freight/lenis` / `lenis` for smooth momentum scrolling.

Ensure `frontend/src/index.css` sets `--font-heading: 'Playfair Display Variable', serif;` and `--font-sans: 'DM Sans Variable', sans-serif;` with imports for `@fontsource-variable/playfair-display` and `@fontsource-variable/dm-sans` and `@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono`.
Build a custom bilingual translation dictionary in `frontend/src/lib/i18n.tsx` or context hook supporting full DE (German) and EN (English) seamless language toggle without page reloads.
Include an interactive Live Price & Long-Stay Calculator where users can toggle days, weeks, months, room type and see their discount in real-time.

In backend (`backend/server.py` or router `backend/routers/inquiries.py`), create `POST /api/inquiries` and `GET /api/inquiries` to record reservation inquiries in MongoDB and simulate email notification.
Ensure the contact form pre-fills whenever a user clicks 'Jetzt anfragen' on a specific room card or from the price calculator.

Mobile-First execution: Monteure & craftsmen search for rooms on their smartphones while on the road or at the job site. Phone buttons and WhatsApp triggers must be tap-friendly with thumb-accessible sticky contact bar on mobile viewports.
Do NOT use default cold blue colors. Stick strictly to the warm organic palette (#FAF7F2 ivory, #C45B28 terracotta/ochre, #1C1917 warm charcoal).
